issues.issue_title: Using document write methods can lead to XSS attacks
issues.issue_description: User controlled data in methods like 'innerHTML', 'outerHTML' or 'document.write' is an anti-pattern that can lead to XSS vulnerabilities.
issues.issue_remediation: Make sure you do not use user input when you are using these methods and if you do, be sure to sanitize the input.

issues.issue_title: Potential file inclusion attack via reading file
issues.issue_description: If an attacker can control the input leading into the open function, they might be able to read sensitive files and launch further attacks with that information.
issues.issue_remediation: Ignore this issue only after you've verified or sanitized the input going into this function.
